text: The lamp. Glass in rings, ground here in the city, turning slowly
on a bath of mercury so that nothing in it ever needs to touch anything else.
From up here the whole bay: the moles, the basin, the deep lane,
and out past all of it a flat grey sea with no weather on it at all.
It has looked exactly like this for three weeks.
Scratched into the sill, small, by somebody bored on a long watch:
IF YOU ARE READING THIS THE LIGHT IS STILL LIT. THAT IS THE WHOLE JOB.
